title: Blizzard Bloom
body:
"Blizzard blooms are delicate flowers that sparkle like freshly fallen snow."

Description

These rare flowers grow in abundance in the little cave/alcove in the Icelands. Has very shiny and has a faint teal glow. Used to craft the Petalfall. It can be sold to Jer Junkman for 150$ per Blizzard Bloom. It can be turned into Dye by using a Press Machine.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~17.97% per flower.
